projects.name: Credit Card (Australia and New Zealand) – May 2023 – May 2026
details: Firserv supports multiple banking clients across Australia and New Zealand, such as NAB,
HKT, PCL, etc for their credit card process in Vision Plus platform. I was handling end-to-end
release management for multiple projects. Handling release planning, change management,
testing coordination, production deployments, and stakeholder governance to ensure
successful and timely releases for various projects.
Responsibilities
• Managed end-to-end release planning by preparing release calendars and defining timelines for
development, SIT, UAT, production deployment, and warranty support.
• Coordinated with Business, Development, QA, Infrastructure, and Support teams to manage
release scope, dependencies, feasibility, and implementation constraints.
• Consolidated project requirements, compliance updates, enhancements, and defect fixes into release notes, while tracking project milestones, risks, defects, and change requests.
• Managed JIRA activities, including features, stories, tasks, and defects, and ensured appropriate
regression testing coverage for releases.
• Facilitated release governance, including Release Readiness Reviews, Go/No-Go meetings, UAT
sign-offs, CAB approvals, production deployments, and Post-Implementation Reviews (PIR).
• Managed the Change Request (CR) lifecycle, maintained project documentation in Confluence,
and coordinated implementation approvals.
• Monitored release risks, issues, and cross -functional dependencies, ensuring successful
production deployments and smooth transition to business-as-usual support.
• Published release status reports and dashboards, providing stakeholders with visibility into project progress, milestones, risks, and release readiness.

projects.name: Sep 2021 – Dec 2022
details: National Australia Bank (NAB) is an Australian financial services company providing payment
processing and financial solutions. The project involved developing an in -house payment
processing platform to support merchant onboarding, payment transactions, and settlement
processing. I managed the project  from discovery  phase through delivery using Agile
methodologies.
Responsibilities
• Conducted discovery workshops, stakeholder meetings, and project kick-off sessions.
• Defined MVP, project scope, delivery roadmap, reporting cadence, and communication plan.
• Managed product backlog, user stories, epics, and sprint backlog in JIRA, ensuring development
readiness through backlog refinement and prioritization.
• Facilitated Agile ceremonies, including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand -ups, Sprint Reviews,
Retrospectives, and tracked progress using burndown charts.
• Collaborated with Product Owners and development teams to define acceptance criteria,
Definition of Done (DoD), and review sprint deliverables.
• Managed project status reporting, risks, issues, dependencies, and escalations, providing
regular updates to stakeholders.
• Coordinated the created of functional workflows, reviewed UAT test cases, and supported
SIT/UAT activities.
• Oversaw development, testing, and successful delivery of merchant onboarding, transaction
processing, and settlement functionalities.

details: Developed a centralized Attra Project Reporting application to provide enterprise -wide
visibility into project health and portfolio performance. The solution enabled role-based access
for Project Managers, PMOs, Account Managers, and Business Unit Heads to manage project
schedules, budgets, resources, milestones, risks, issues, and status. As a Business Analyst
and Project Manager, I led requirement gathering, implementation, and subsequent
enhancement releases from project inception.

• Coordinated with Development, QA, and UAT teams to ensure timely delivery.
• Performed feasibility analysis, effort estimation, and project tracking.
• Created and managed JIRA work items, including user stories, tasks, and subtasks.
• Managed project risks, issues, dependencies, and action items.
• Presented project status to stakeholders and steering committees.
• Ensured deliverables aligned with business requirements and project objectives.
• Oversaw development and testing for merchant onboarding, transaction processing, and
settlement.

projects.name: (Ratnakar Bank Limited), Mumbai – Aug 2017 – Aug 2020
details: Worked on the migration of RBL Bank's Credit Card platform from VisionPLUS 8.57 to VisionPLUS 10, supporting downstream applications including Loyalty, Customer Statements
(HP Exstream), Alerts, 3DS ACS, and Disputes.
Responsibilities
• Performed business and impact analysis for VisionPLUS platform changes and assessed their
impact on downstream applications.
• Defined business and ETL requirements, including standardized pipe -delimited extracts, to ensure consistent data delivery to downstream systems during the VisionPLUS migration.
• Collaborated with business, development, ETL, and vendor teams to analyse requirements and
ensure seamless integration across dependent applications.
• Delivered enhancements to the Loyalty Management System, including cashback, reward
calculations, redemption rules, loyalty campaigns, and branding updates.
• Designed and implemented customized credit card statements using HP Exstream by defining
business rules for reward calculations and integrating dynamic marketing content.
• Worked on customer Alerts (Batch & Online), 3DS ACS implementation, and Disputes testing.
• Coordinated SIT, Functional UAT, and UAT, managed defects, change requests, requirement
clarifications, and obtained business sign-offs.
• Supported production deployments by collaborating with business and technical teams to ensure
successful implementation with minimal business disruption.

projects.name: Management (Citi - APAC Region) – Jun 2015 – Aug 2017
details: The project involved delivering regulatory and business initiatives across Citi's APAC card
platforms. Managed end-to-end project delivery for multiple regional implementations,
coordinating business, technology, and testing teams to ensure timely implementation of
regulatory and business-driven system changes.
Responsibilities
• Handling system implementation as per the regulatory and business requirement from various
regions after going through BRD (Business Requirement Document).
• Coordinating with stakeholders for getting the UAT and FUAT testing completed.
• Detailed Project planning and developing, like preparing a project plan, resources requirement,
and timeframe.
• Mastercard-related Cards/Payments programmes, giving him strong practical understanding of
the Mastercard ecosystem and card-payment lifecycle.
• Regulatory & scheme requirements: His Mastercard experience is highly relevant to the Capco
requirement around scheme mandates, regulatory changes, compliance requirements, and
implementation of changes across card platforms.
• Cards & Payments:
• Strong hands-on experience across the end-to-end credit-card lifecycle, including card issuance,
authorization, transaction processing, billing, payments, disputes and chargebacks, clearing,
settlement, and reconciliation. Experienced in VisionPLUS implementations, platform
migrations, testing, release management, and production deployments.
• Visa/Mastercard Regulatory & Compliance Releases:
• Managed Visa- and Mastercard-mandated regulatory and compliance changes as part of the
Fiserv–ANZ Release Management programme, covering scope consolidation, regulatory impact
assessment, release planning, risk and dependency management, SIT/UAT coordination, CAB
approvals, Go/No-Go readiness, production deployment, and post-implementation support.
• Mastercard Certification & EMV Migration:
• Hands-on experience with Mastercard certification activities during magnetic-stripe-to-EMV
chip-card migration programmes at TCS, including transaction validation, PIN-exchange
requirements, and white-plastic card certification activities prior to production rollout.
• End-to-end Cards expertise: Combined with his experience in credit cards, authorization,
disputes, settlement, reconciliation, AML/KYC and risk/control testing, he brings both Mastercard
domain knowledge and regulatory/risk expertise —which is exactly the c ombination Capco is
looking for.
• Managing project deliverables in line with the project plan.
• Risk Assessment and Risk analysis using through register and possible threats that will face in
the project.
• Global testing for Citi Product, reviewing Test Plan, strategy, Test Metrics.
• PVT - Insertion of transaction points, parameterization for Risk analytics and payments in cards.

projects.name: Money Laundering – Transactions Surveillance Unit – Apr 2014 – May 2015
details: The AML Transaction Surveillance Unit was responsible for monitoring financial transactions
to identify suspicious activities and ensure compliance with Anti-Money Laundering
regulations. As a Subject Matter Expert and Quality Assurance Manager, I managed quality
reviews, audit compliance, and continuous process improvement initiatives.
Responsibilities
• Managed internal audit and quality control reviews for AML case processing.
• Analyzed payment transactions for unusual activity.
• Reviewed CDD, EDD, public domain, and watchlist information.
• Conducted regular huddles to improve quality and decision-making.

projects.name: (North America Operations – Control Testing Unit) – Sep 2007-Apr 2014
details: The North America Operations Control Testing Unit was responsible for performing
operational risk and control testing across banking operations to ensure compliance with
regulatory requirements and internal control standards. Managed a team responsible for

entry.text: Project: Fiserv - Credit Card (Australia and New Zealand) – May 2023 – May 2026
Firserv supports multiple banking clients across Australia and New Zealand, such as NAB,
HKT, PCL, etc for their credit card process in Vision Plus platform. I was handling end-to-end
release management for multiple projects. Handling release planning, change management,
testing coordination, production deployments, and stakeholder governance to ensure
successful and timely releases for various projects.
Role: Business Analyst / Release Manager
Responsibilities
• Managed end-to-end release planning by preparing release calendars and defining timelines for
development, SIT, UAT, production deployment, and warranty support.
• Coordinated with Business, Development, QA, Infrastructure, and Support teams to manage
release scope, dependencies, feasibility, and implementation constraints.
• Consolidated project requirements, compliance updates, enhancements, and defect fixes into
release notes, while tracking project milestones, risks, defects, and change requests.
• Managed JIRA activities, including features, stories, tasks, and defects, and ensured appropriate
regression testing coverage for releases.
• Facilitated release governance, including Release Readiness Reviews, Go/No-Go meetings, UAT
sign-offs, CAB approvals, production deployments, and Post-Implementation Reviews (PIR).
• Managed the Change Request (CR) lifecycle, maintained project documentation in Confluence,
and coordinated implementation approvals.
• Monitored release risks, issues, and cross -functional dependencies, ensuring successful
production deployments and smooth transition to business-as-usual support.
• Published release status reports and dashboards, providing stakeholders with visibility into
project progress, milestones, risks, and release readiness.
